
Agent guidance treats rules as the thing being designed. The authoring skills, `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/agent-surfaces.md` direct an agent to find the affected rules (`lode search`, `lode rule list`), change them with `lode rule add`, `edit`, `link` and `supersede`, and change a spec only to change its arrangement. A plan's `covers` names rule refs. Document and section entries stay valid shorthand that resolves to rules (section 4).
